verdict.rationale: Kimi Code ships a terminal CLI, but the evidence describes only an interactive chat session that starts with `kimi` and an in-session `/login` command. Nothing documents a non-interactive, headless, scripted or CI mode. The OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API with API keys and the ACP editor protocol are developer building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented way to run the agent itself in automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Chat with AI in the terminal, letting it read code, edit files, execute commands, search the web, and autonomously complete development tasks.
run `kimi` in the terminal to start; on first use, log in to the Kimi Code platform with the `/login` command to complete the connection
